market_analysis.market_type_reason: B2B: the buyers are businesses, utilities and public agencies (Infrastructure owners, EPC contractors, government agencies, industrial plant operators, real-estate managers, insurance companies).
market_analysis.market_definition: The India Drone-Based Infrastructure Inspection Market covers companies delivering the following. Products and technology: Drone type: multirotor, FPV, tethered, drone-in-a-box; payload: high-resolution RGB, zoom, thermal, LiDAR, ultrasonic, gas sensor; software: defect tagging, AI analytics, CMMS/BIM integration. Services and business models: One-time inspection, recurring inspection contract, drone-in-a-box program, managed inspection service, data-processing and reporting service. Applications: Buildings, bridges, roads, railways, tunnels, dams, industrial plants, chimneys, solar farms, wind turbines, construction sites. End users: Infrastructure owners, EPC contractors, government agencies, industrial plant operators, real-estate managers, insurance companies. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India (a foreign company's Indian office, branch or distributor does not qualify).
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player itself delivers drone-based inspection of infrastructure under its own name (bridges, roads, railways, tunnels, dams, buildings, industrial plants, chimneys, solar farms, wind turbines, construction sites) as one-time or recurring inspection, managed inspection or drone-in-a-box programmes, with data processing and reporting; including inspection-software and drone-in-a-box providers that run inspection programmes for clients.
adjacent_segments: Drone hardware makers that only sell drones
Manual (rope-access / NDT) inspection firms with no drone service
Software-only asset-management vendors with no inspection operation
